description: This source file defines structures and functions for managing device authentication tokens and their persistent storage in a JSON file. It includes the representation of auth entries, storage mechanics, and token management methods.

methods.name: loadToken
methods.description: Loads a device authentication token for a specified device ID and role if present.

methods.name: storeToken
methods.description: Stores or updates a device authentication token for a specified device ID and role.

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Removes a token for a specific device ID and role from storage.

methods.name: normalizeRole
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newline characters from a role string.

methods.name: normalizeScopes
methods.description: Trims whitespace from each scope in a list, removes empty scopes, and returns a sorted set of unique scopes.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Constructs the file URL for the JSON storage file.

methods.name: readStore
methods.description: Reads and decodes the JSON file into a DeviceAuthStoreFile object if possible.

methods.name: writeStore
methods.description: Encodes and writes the DeviceAuthStoreFile object to disk, creating directories and setting permissions.
